note: AM run. Checked 75 people (all from the 2026-11-15 tier; 51 of that tier remain for the PM run) and filed 5 bullets across 4 people, each verified on its source page by the parent and read back in the Sheet exactly once. Fresh sweep: none found — a dedicated Oct 30 to Nov 20 sweep across North Country Now, NCPR, NNY360, WWNY, ClickNNY, the four colleges' news and athletics, honors announcements, and health-system news found every in-window, anchor-tied directory item already on file (Michelle Johnston's Oct 30 Shaffer Award, Zvi Szafran's Nov 5 Bridge to a Million quote, Mark C Walczyk's Nov 4 re-election win, and the Clarkson women's hockey lines through Nov 14); the Clarkson Healthcare launch quoting Lennart Johns carries no publication date on the opened page, so it was not filed; all three fresh slots were left empty rather than stretched. Filed: Annika Greco authored a Pentecost reflection on generosity for the Diocese of Chester's Wholehearted magazine, Issue 2, 2026, under her married name Annika Greco Thompson from Stewardship; Jaime Bicknell was a candidate for ACAPT Nominating Committee Member on the official 2025 slate and served as lead coordinator of the Potsdam Town and Country Club Ladies Golf League in Summer 2023; Jillian Chapman received a $1,000 Massena Hospital Auxiliary scholarship in 2020 and entered Daemen College's Physician Assistant program, a second scholarship distinct from the Evergreen STEM award already on file; and Emily Criscitello, as a MAC-HA Exploration Project team member in the Tulum region, helped document pottery, charcoal and apparent constructed platforms in the cave system, photographed in place and left undisturbed with INAH representatives consulted — new archaeology detail expanding her filed MAC-HA bullet. Logged, not filed (Luna's call under the Nov 4 rule, kept out of JD's queue): Ian Bailey's canned-coffee release detail, sourced only to a vendor article built from his own interview; Julia Tomford's photography pricing, published only on her own site; Lawrence Kring's WebMD listing naming Claxton Hepburn Medical Center, a single aggregator page that conflicts with the Rochester Regional Health affiliation on file, so nothing was filed and no field was changed; Loni Hughes Recker's SLELO PRISM project-completion detail, which covers the same Remington Museum project already on file; Jaime Bicknell's NY/NJ Consortium chair start, given as 2024 on the ACAPT slate and August 2022 on her Clarkson profile, so neither date was filed; and Josiah Tabolt's 2007 SUNY Poly coursework page and self-reported BiggerPockets listing. 3 candidates added to Research Command (ledger 674), all identity holds: Jessica Osypiewski (a 2021 Wilson Hill Turtle Trot result from Chase Mills, with no school or employer tie on the page) and Cody Benham twice, from two different sources (15th in MA1 at the July 2025 Clay Park Classic on Disc Golf Scene, and 7th in B-Intermediate at CNYDGA Wednesday Singles on UDisc — both pages name him and his division but give no town to tie him to Watertown). 0 of JD's console 'file' decision points reconciled into changes.json.
